exercise.name: Incline Dumbbell Skull Crusher
library_steps: Lie back on an incline bench, dumbbells held straight up, palms facing in.
Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells behind your head.
Straighten your arms back up without moving your upper arms.
exercise.one_line_summary: 30 deg incline bench, both arms straight up (vertical in the room), palms facing in; only the elbows bend, to ~95 deg, so the dumbbells drop behind the head. Triceps (long head stretched) does the work.

setup.why: Incline puts the shoulder in more flexion than a flat skull crusher (more overhead), which favours the long head.

setup.target: Hips on the seat, back and head on the pad, feet flat.
Arms straight up (vertical in the room), shoulder-width, palms facing each other.
setup.tolerance: upper arm within 10 deg of vertical
setup.why: Library start; upper arms then stay still.

movement.end: 95 deg (dumbbells behind and beside the head)

movement.measure: upper arm angle from the torso; stays still

muscles.emg: Lying extension 62% of triangle push-up (S1). Shoulder-flexed elbow extension grew the long head +28.5% vs +19.6% neutral (S2).

muscles.muscle: Shoulder flexors / extensors holding the upper arm
Lats (eccentric hold of the overhead upper arm)

mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Elbows flare out or swing toward the feet as the weight comes up.
mistakes.why_it_matters: Library cue: do not move the upper arms; otherwise it becomes a pullover-press.

mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Elbows point out to the sides instead of up.
mistakes.why_it_matters: Shortens the range and loads the elbow unevenly.

sources.citation: Boehler B, Porcari JP, Kline D, Hendrix CR, Foster C, Anders M. 2011. ACE-sponsored research: best triceps exercises. ACE Certified News, Aug 2011.
sources.what_it_gave: Lying barbell extension 62%, overhead extension 76%, kickback 87% of the triangle push-up; stationary upper arm.

sources.citation: Maeo S, Wu Y, Huang M, et al. 2023. Triceps brachii hypertrophy is substantially greater after elbow extension training performed in the overhead versus neutral arm position. Eur J Sport Sci 23(7):1240-1250.
sources.what_it_gave: Overhead (shoulder-flexed) training: long head 1.5x and whole triceps 1.4x the growth of the neutral arm.

sources.citation: Rodriguez-Ridao D, Antequera-Vique JA, Martin-Fuentes I, Muyor JM. 2020. Effect of five bench inclinations on the EMG activity of the pectoralis major, anterior deltoid, and triceps brachii during the bench press exercise. IJERPH 17(19):7339.
sources.what_it_gave: Bench angle definitions (0-60 deg) and the head-and-back-on-bench setup used for the 30 deg body.
